# `vios_label` tools

7 tools in the `vios_label` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_create_vios_vfc_group_label` | `mutate` | `vios_label.create_vfc_group` | `managed_system` | Create one vFC placement group without adding or deleting adapters. |
| `hmc_list_vios_fc_port_labels` | `read` | `vios_label.list_fc_ports` | `managed_system` | List FC-port labels used for migration placement without changing adapters. |

| `hmc_set_vios_fc_port_label` | `mutate` | `vios_label.set_fc_port` | `managed_system` | Set one FC-port migration label without adding or deleting adapters. |
